description.text: Why choosing this program?The university’s discipline of architecture takes the leading position home and abroad and keeps an increasing influence in the world. The graduates, including some prominent members of the Academy of Engineering of China and many noted experts, have contributed a lot to the development of architecture.Main CoursesFundamentals of Architectural Design, The Principle of Architecture Design, History of Chinese and Foreign Architecuture, Building Structure and Architectural Mechanics, Building Construction etc.InternshipGraduates will have many practical teaching, including art practice, site practice, construction practice of surveying and mapping, practice of knowing architecture, design institute production practice. After this program study, students can work as a designer in design departments and become advanced engineering technicians.Diploma AwardedBachelor of Architecture by Southeast University

duration.text: The Architecture at Southeast University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4000 USD/per year ￥ 28800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. SEU Application Form for International Students2. Senior high school diploma3. High school transcripts4. Authorized Copy of TOEFL score 500 or above, or IELTS score 5.0 or above for those applicants whose mother tongue or official language is not English.5. Valid passport copy6. All the application materials are nonreturnable.

requirements.text: 1. Over 16 year’s old2. High school graduate or above 3. Healthy foreigners
